Load packages and data
```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

raw_data <- read_csv("HandWashingData.csv")

```

```{r}

data <- raw_data %>% group_by(sex) %>% mutate(Mean = mean(washes), sds=sd(washes), count=n(), ses=sds/sqrt(count), cis=1.96*ses)

```

Summary table
```{r}

summary_table <- data %>% summarise(Mean = mean(washes), sds=sd(washes), count=n(), ses=sds/sqrt(count), cis=1.96*ses)

```

Plots
```{r}

plot <- ggplot(data, aes(x=washes, color=sex, fill=sex))

```

```{r}
plot + geom_histogram()

```

```{r}

plot + geom_boxplot()

```

```{r}

plot + geom_freqpoly()

```

```{r}

ggplot(summary_table, aes(x=sex, y=Mean)) + geom_point() + geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Mean - cis, ymax = Mean + cis))

```
